document.abstract: IEXTEND greetings and regret my inability to be among you at your gathering in Boston. Could I be with you I would undoubtedly talk along different lines than will be expressed here with. However, I am going to endeavor to call your attention to the much needed improvement necessary to lighting equipment as used today in motion picture studios for photographic purposes.
